title: Guides

meta.title: GIF guides — formats, file size, frame rates and Discord limits
meta.description: Written explanations of the things people actually get stuck on: which format to use, why a GIF is enormous, what Discord really accepts, and why frame rates behave strangely.

lead: Six pages about how GIFs actually work, written because the answers were hard to find and mostly wrong when they were. None of them is a pitch for a tool. They are the explanations that were needed while the tools were being built, written down properly instead of left in a comment.
closing: Every figure on these pages is either a property of the file format, something the code on this site does and can be read, or a number published by the platform it describes — in which case it is shown with the date it was last checked and a link to the source. Where something is a convention rather than a documented rule, it says so.
Nothing here is padded to reach a word count and nothing was assembled from a template. If a page seems short, it is because the question was small.
